data.name: cli.root.description
data.value: Runs commands against the running Hephaestus installation.

data.name: cli.help.option-json
data.value: Prints one JSON document and nothing else.

data.name: cli.not-understood.unmatched
data.value: Unrecognized command or argument '{0}'. Run 'hephaestus --help' to list the commands and options.

data.name: cli.unreachable.detail
data.value: Nothing answered on the control socket {0}. Check that the container is running with 'docker compose ps', and run the command inside it with 'docker exec hephaestus hephaestus'.

data.name: cli.bad-answer.detail
data.value: The API failed with status {0} and did not describe the failure.

data.name: problem.not-found.detail
data.value: The API has no endpoint at {0}.

data.name: problem.method-not-allowed.detail
data.value: The endpoint {1} does not accept the method {0}.

data.name: problem.unexpected.detail
data.value: Hephaestus could not complete the request. The log has the details.

data.name: problem.failed.detail
data.value: The API refused the request with status {0}.

data.name: cli.secret.description
data.value: Stores credentials as files outside the database.

data.name: cli.secret.set.description
data.value: Stores a secret whose value is read from standard input.

data.name: cli.secret.list.description
data.value: Lists the names of the stored secrets.

data.name: cli.secret.value-argument.title
data.value: A secret value cannot be given on the command line

data.name: cli.secret.value-argument.detail
data.value: Nothing was stored. Give the value on standard input instead, for example: docker exec -i hephaestus hephaestus secret set <name> < value.txt

data.name: problem.secret-name-invalid.detail
data.value: A secret name has 1 to {0} characters: lowercase letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores, starting with a letter or a digit.

data.name: problem.secret-value-empty.detail
data.value: Nothing was stored. Give the value on standard input.

data.name: problem.secret-value-too-short.detail
data.value: Nothing was stored. A secret value has at least {0} characters.

data.name: problem.secret-value-too-long.detail
data.value: Nothing was stored. A secret value has at most {0} characters.

data.name: problem.secret-not-found.detail
data.value: No secret is stored under the name {0}.

data.name: problem.secret-value-not-text.detail
data.value: Nothing was stored. A secret value is UTF-8 text; the input held bytes that are not.

data.name: cli.github.description
data.value: Connects Hephaestus's own GitHub App and checks what it may do.

data.name: cli.github.connect.description
data.value: Connects the GitHub App; its private key is read from standard input.

data.name: cli.github.check.description
data.value: Reads the App's identity, installations, and permissions from GitHub.

data.name: cli.github.option-app-id
data.value: The App's id, shown on its settings page on GitHub.

data.name: cli.github.connect-arguments.title
data.value: The command was not understood, and the private key cannot be given on the command line

data.name: cli.github.connect-arguments.detail
data.value: Nothing was stored. Give only --app-id and put the key on standard input, for example: docker exec -i hephaestus hephaestus github connect --app-id <id> < key.pem

data.name: cli.github.installations.none
data.value: Not installed anywhere yet. Install the App on the repositories Hephaestus is to work on.

data.name: cli.github.installation.suspended
data.value: suspended; its repositories are not listed

data.name: cli.github.warning
data.value: Warning: the App is granted {0} at level {1}. Hephaestus never needs it. Remove it in the App's settings on GitHub.

data.name: cli.github.not-ready
data.value: Some required permissions are missing. Grant them in the App's settings on GitHub, then run github check.

data.name: problem.github-not-connected.detail
data.value: Nothing was changed. Connect the App first: github connect --app-id <id>, with the private key on standard input.

data.name: problem.github-credential-rejected.detail
data.value: GitHub refused the App id and private key. Nothing was changed. Check that the id belongs to the App, that the key was generated for it and has not been revoked, and that the host's clock is right to within a minute.

data.name: problem.github-key-unreadable.detail
data.value: The private key is not a PEM-encoded RSA private key, so GitHub was not asked. Nothing was changed. Give the .pem file GitHub offered when the key was generated.

data.name: problem.github-unreachable.detail
data.value: GitHub did not answer, or answered that it could not serve the request. Nothing was changed. Check the host's network and try again.

data.name: problem.github-app-id-invalid.detail
data.value: Nothing was changed. The App id is a positive whole number, shown on the App's settings page on GitHub.

data.name: cli.trusted-user.description
data.value: Manages the GitHub users Hephaestus acts on.

data.name: cli.trusted-user.add.description
data.value: Adds a Trusted User by GitHub login; Hephaestus stores GitHub's numeric user id.

data.name: cli.trusted-user.already
data.value: {0} (GitHub user id {1}) is already a Trusted User. Nothing was added.

data.name: problem.trusted-user-login-invalid.detail
data.value: Nothing was changed. A GitHub login has letters, digits, and hyphens, and at most 39 characters.

data.name: problem.trusted-user-github-not-found.detail
data.value: GitHub has no user with the login {0}. Nothing was changed.

data.name: problem.trusted-user-own-identity.detail
data.value: {0} is the bot account of Hephaestus's own GitHub App. It is never a Trusted User. Nothing was changed.

data.name: problem.trusted-user-not-found.detail
data.value: {0} is not a Trusted User. Nothing was changed. Run trusted-user list to see who is.

data.name: cli.alias.description
data.value: Manages Aliases: names for an Agent with a Model, or for an Effort.

data.name: cli.alias.add.description
data.value: Adds an Alias for an Agent and a Model (--agent and --model), or for an Effort (--effort).

data.name: cli.alias.option.agent
data.value: The Agent the Alias names: claude-code or codex-cli.

data.name: cli.alias.option.model
data.value: The Model the Alias names, as its vendor spells it, for example claude-opus-5-5.

data.name: cli.alias.option.effort
data.value: The Effort the Alias names: low, medium, high, xhigh, or max.

data.name: cli.alias.already.model
data.value: The Alias {0} (Agent {1}, Model {2}) is already defined. Nothing changed.

data.name: cli.alias.already.effort
data.value: The Alias {0} (Effort {1}) is already defined. Nothing changed.

data.name: problem.alias-name-invalid.detail
data.value: Nothing changed. An Alias name has 1 to {0} characters: lower case letters, digits, dots, hyphens, and underscores, starting with a letter or digit.

data.name: problem.alias-incomplete.title
data.value: An Alias names an Agent and a Model, or an Effort

data.name: problem.alias-incomplete.detail
data.value: Nothing changed. Give --agent and --model together, or --effort alone.

data.name: problem.alias-agent-unknown.detail
data.value: Nothing changed. '{0}' is not an Agent Hephaestus drives. Use one of: {1}.

data.name: problem.alias-model-invalid.detail
data.value: Nothing changed. A Model is written as its vendor spells it: up to {0} letters, digits, and the characters . _ : / @ -, starting with a letter or digit.

data.name: problem.alias-effort-unknown.detail
data.value: Nothing changed. '{0}' is not an Effort. Use one of: {1}.

data.name: problem.alias-defined-differently.detail
data.value: {0} is already an Alias for something else. Nothing changed. Remove it with 'alias remove {0}' before defining it again.

data.name: problem.alias-not-found.detail
data.value: {0} is not an Alias. Nothing changed. Run alias list to see the Aliases.

data.name: cli.limit.description
data.value: Shows and sets the installation limits that no Project Configuration can raise.

data.name: cli.limit.set.description
data.value: Sets the limits named by the options and keeps the others.

data.name: cli.limit.option.task-duration
data.value: The longest a Task may run, for example 90m or 2h30m (1 minute to 7 days).

data.name: cli.limit.option.cpus
data.value: The most processors a Task's container may use, for example 2 or 1.5 (0.1 to 1024).

data.name: cli.limit.option.memory
data.value: The most memory a Task's container may use, for example 512m or 4g (64m to 4096g).

data.name: problem.limit-nothing-given.detail
data.value: Nothing changed. Name at least one of --task-duration, --cpus, and --memory.

data.name: problem.limit-task-duration-invalid.detail
data.value: Nothing changed. '{0}' is not a duration between 1 minute and 7 days. Write days, hours, minutes, and seconds as whole numbers, for example 90m or 2h30m.

data.name: problem.limit-cpus-invalid.detail
data.value: Nothing changed. '{0}' is not a number of processors. Write a number from 0.1 to 1024 with at most three decimals, for example 2 or 1.5.

data.name: problem.limit-memory-invalid.detail
data.value: Nothing changed. '{0}' is not an amount of memory from 64m to 4096g. Write a whole number and k, m, or g, for example 512m or 4g.

data.name: cli.protected-path.description
data.value: Manages the protected paths: globs that an Agent's change may never touch.

data.name: cli.protected-path.already
data.value: {0} is already a protected path. Nothing added.

data.name: problem.protected-path-invalid.detail
data.value: Nothing changed. A protected path is a relative glob such as docs/** of at most {0} characters: no leading or trailing slash, no empty, . or .. segment, no backslash, and no control character.

data.name: problem.protected-path-not-found.detail
data.value: {0} is not a protected path. Nothing changed. Run protected-path list to see the list.

data.name: cli.setting.description
data.value: Shows and sets the installation settings that have a default.

data.name: cli.setting.list.description
data.value: Lists the settings with their values and defaults.

data.name: cli.setting.set.description
data.value: Sets a setting, for example: setting set language pl.

data.name: problem.setting-unknown.detail
data.value: {0} is not a setting. Nothing changed. Run setting list to see the settings.

data.name: problem.setting-value-invalid.detail
data.value: '{1}' is not a value of the setting {0}. Nothing changed. Use one of: {2}.

data.name: cli.config.show.description
data.value: Shows the whole Installation Configuration: Trusted Users, Aliases, limits, protected paths, settings, and secrets by name only.

data.name: problem.request-invalid.detail
data.value: Nothing changed. The request body is not the JSON document this endpoint takes.

data.name: cli.project.description
data.value: Manages the GitHub repositories Hephaestus works on.

data.name: cli.project.add.description
data.value: Registers a repository the GitHub App is installed on as a Project, with its Base Branch.

data.name: cli.project.list.description
data.value: Lists the Projects Hephaestus works on.

data.name: cli.project.remove.description
data.value: Removes a Project from the ones Hephaestus works on; its record is kept.

data.name: cli.project.option.base-branch
data.value: The branch Tasks start from and pull requests are merged into.

data.name: cli.project.option.all
data.value: Also lists the Projects that were removed.

data.name: cli.project.added
data.value: Registered Project {0} (GitHub repository id {1}) with Base Branch {2}.

data.name: cli.project.updated
data.value: Updated Project {0} (GitHub repository id {1}): its Base Branch is {2}.

data.name: cli.project.already
data.value: {0} (GitHub repository id {1}) is already registered with Base Branch {2}. Nothing was changed.

data.name: cli.project.removed
data.value: Removed Project {0} (GitHub repository id {1}). Its record and everything recorded under it are kept.

data.name: cli.project.branch-protected
data.value: GitHub reports Base Branch {0} as protected.

data.name: cli.project.branch-unprotected
data.value: GitHub reports Base Branch {0} as not protected. Protect it against direct pushes on GitHub (a branch protection rule or a ruleset), so that nothing reaches it without a pull request.

data.name: cli.project.list.empty
data.value: No Projects. Register one with: project add <owner>/<repo> --base-branch <branch>

data.name: problem.project-name-invalid.detail
data.value: Nothing was changed. A Project is named owner/repo, for example acme/shop.

data.name: problem.project-branch-invalid.detail
data.value: Nothing was changed. The Base Branch is not a valid git branch name.

data.name: problem.project-not-installed.title
data.value: The GitHub App is not installed on the repository

data.name: problem.project-not-installed.detail
data.value: The Hephaestus GitHub App is not installed on {0}, or the repository does not exist. Install the App on it (docs/github-app.md) and run the command again. Nothing was changed.

data.name: problem.project-branch-not-found.title
data.value: The Base Branch does not exist

data.name: problem.project-branch-not-found.detail
data.value: {0} has no branch named {1}. Nothing was changed.

data.name: problem.project-not-registered.detail
data.value: {0} is not a registered Project. Nothing was changed. Run project list to see which are.
